This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for July 2, 2026.

Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition.

1. 'Two weeks after her death I got a call': Gaza patients face agonising delays for evacuation. An estimated 300 Palestinians referred for treatment abroad have died since the ceasefire began, according to Gaza's Hamas-run health ministry. This was reported by BBC News.

2. 'Collateral damage': 73 Palestinian children Israel shot in the head. Israel has rejected a UN Commission report that says its army deliberately targets Palestinian children. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

3. Gaza war's 1,000 days: 90% of strip 'destroyed', 80% 'seized' by Israel. In 1,000 days since October 7, 2023, Gaza lies in ruins, Board of Peace falters and. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

4. Gaza's first women's amputee football team reclaims the pitch after war. Gaza's first women's amputee football team is reclaiming a space that war tried to take from them. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

5. Rally for Luxembourg teacher fired over pro-Gaza posts. Students and supporters of a Luxembourg teacher fired over social media posts held a demonstration for her this week. This was reported by Al Jazeera.

6. AFP assessing allegation of Gaza war crimes committed by Australian citizen serving in IDF. Israel Defense Forces in Gaza. This was reported by The Guardian.

For the full source-backed dispatch, read the July 2, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
